title: Nonsmooth Homogeneous Complex Monge–Ampère Solutions
statement: How can one construct a solution $u$ of the homogeneous complex Monge–Ampère equation on $\mathbb{P}^1$ times the unit disc that fails to be $C^2$, including at an interior point?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Geometric Methods of Complex Analysis (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/25, pp. 1291--1345](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/25)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The 2021 report leaves the explicit construction of a solution outside C^2 on P^1\times D unresolved; later work constructs non-maximal-rank solutions but states that the precise regularity failure is not determined.

**Sources checked.**

- [Oberwolfach report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/25)
- [Ross--Witt Nystr\"om, maximal rank](https://doi.org/10.2140/apde.2019.12.493)
